title: Asking the app build script for help no longer rebuilds the dev app
goal: Running the app build script with a flag it does not know, such as --help, quietly starts a full rebuild of the person's own dev app instead of printing how to use it, which would quit the app they are using. It should print its usage and stop for anything it does not recognise.
notes: Reproduced 2026-10-02 by a runner on task a-far-playhead-jump-on-a-zoomed-in-long-recordin: `Scripts/build-app.sh --help 2>&1 | head -5` printed `==> Building Photonz 0.15.0 (dev, arm64)` then `Building for production...`. It was only stopped because `head` closed the pipe (SIGPIPE); dist/Photonz Dev.app kept its 05:34 binary. queue/playtest.lock did not exist at the time, so the dev-build guard would not have refused. Cause: Scripts/build-app.sh only compares "${1:-}" against --release/--dmg/--dmg-only/--probe (lines 40, 95, 354); anything else falls through to the default dev build. Fix: a case on $1 at the top that handles the known flags and prints the header comment (lines 4-35) for -h/--help/anything else, exit 2.
acceptance: Scripts/build-app.sh --help prints the usage lines at the top of the script and exits without building anything
Any other unknown first argument is refused with the usage and a non-zero exit, and dist/Photonz Dev.app is untouched
--probe, --release, --dmg, --dmg-only and no argument behave exactly as before

log.note: Reproduced in a sandbox copy with a stub swift: --help, -h and --bogus each printed '==> Building Photonz 0.15.0 (dev, arm64)' and called swift build. Fixed with a case on $1 before anything else runs.

Scripts/build-app.sh (0ab565a8): -h/--help print the header-comment usage and exit 0; an unknown option or a second argument prints usage to stderr and exits 2. Checked in a sandbox copy with a stub swift: '', --probe, --release, --dmg pick the same variant as before, and --dmg-only still checks for the app. On the real repo --help exits 0, --nope exits 2, and the dev app binary's mtime didn't change. Scripts/test.sh green (11190 tests).
